cases.topic: Should the municipality operate late-night buses?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Late-night buses would give shift workers a reliable way home.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Who would drive the overnight routes?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The buses could also stop near the main hospital.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The municipal transit department would assign its existing night-shift drivers.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I agree that the existing night-shift drivers can handle the routes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: A late-night network would require a subsidy the council cannot afford.

cases.topic: Should the town cover its weekend market stalls?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Covered market stalls would protect vendors from heavy rain.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What would the canopies cost each year?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The town should publish a map of stall locations.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The canopies would cost twelve thousand dollars per year.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Which estimate supports that annual canopy cost?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I do not have the supplier estimate with me.

cases.topic: Should universities lend portable science kits?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Loaned science kits could let remote students complete their experiments.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Where would students return the kits?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The collection point would be next to the science library entrance.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The kits might be returned with missing components, leaving other students unable to finish.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Each borrower could sign a checklist so missing components are replaced before the kit is lent again.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The university should collect anonymous feedback about loan times.

cases.topic: Should residents get free garden plots?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Gardens would increase access to fresh produce.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How many plots could the city provide?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The program could start on June 12.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We estimate ninety plots across the three parks.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: For example, families could grow vegetables they would otherwise have to buy.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What evidence shows that gardens lower grocery bills?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I decline to answer that question.

cases.topic: Should city libraries add accessible printing stations?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Accessible printers would make public documents easier to obtain.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How would people who cannot operate a touchscreen use the printers?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: An attendant at the service desk can take a file and print it on request.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I agree that a service desk attendant would make printing easier.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The library should run workshops on digital literacy.
